verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents management endpoints for creating and rotating API keys programmatically. A community user corroborates minting keys with per-key expiry and limits. Workspace budgets exist, but the evidence never shows them being set through the admin API. Nothing shows gateways or workspaces being provisioned programmatically either. missing for 10: programmatic budget/spend-limit provisioning via API, programmatic gateway/workspace provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration of the admin API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision gateways, keys, and budgets programmatically through an admin API

citations.quote: OpenRouter provides endpoints to programmatically manage your API keys, enabling key creation and management for applications that need to distribute or rotate keys automatically.
One thing that OpenRouter makes easy is the ability to manage API keys (mint new ones, expiry/limits per key, etc.)
Workspace budgets let you cap how much a workspace can spend on OpenRouter inference.
